string_values: Partial near-surface Guinea Current from Cape Palmas offshore approach to the 2E weakening-region convention. Exclude upstream equatorial countercurrent, westward Guinea Counter Current, Guinea Under Current, equatorial South Equatorial Current, plume recirculation and detached eddies as targets. Broad-gate eastward maxima do not independently identify named-current membership. Complete upper200m support may omit shallow coastal columns. Source summer upper50m description is context, not a fixed model cutoff or a forced bottom.
Inclusive component-thickness lower support under original contiguous piecewise-linear model definition; single-level zero is an uninformative bound, not absence.

temporal_scope: January15 and July15,2022 at00Z; two instantaneous snapshots, not seasonal means or annual extrema.
method: Finite paired component contours and unique linear strips on consecutive native latitude columns, all fourteen cases in one cumulative descriptor query.
window_interpretation: Original global0-200m core-selection stratum is not current thickness, a depth cap, instrument limit or seabed. Complete upper200m support may omit shallow shelf flow. Summer upper50m literature context is not imposed on model boundaries.
surface_gate_interpretation: Strict positive5cm/s applies to the original selected profile. It does not imply every connected run touches the surface, or add a surface gate to other columns.
layer_metric_interpretation: Paired thickness is lower minus upper, not depth from surface or core depth. Minimum span is first-to-last native contiguous support under the original piecewise-linear component model, not a physical body bound.
range_interpretation: Native sampling-bracket scenarios are not confidence intervals, physical uncertainty or seasonal ranges.
identity_scope: Partial near-surface Guinea Current from Cape Palmas offshore approach to the 2E weakening-region convention. Exclude upstream equatorial countercurrent, westward Guinea Counter Current, Guinea Under Current, equatorial South Equatorial Current, plume recirculation and detached eddies as targets. axis_anchor_interpretation: Original selected regional model proxies, not independently identified current axes. No selection, gate, threshold, core or date changes.
interpretation: Partial fixed-longitude component geometry, not independently flow-normal width, complete cross-section, physical bottom, route interpolation, terrain clearance or physical water volume. Separate undercurrent and mesoscale contributions remain possible. Undeclared parent context stays unknown.
